title: Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement: Vehicle Document, Compliance Period and Vehicle Change Terms by Class
content:
**Vehicle obligations schedule — Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement.** For every space class the tenant keeps a current state registration in the tenant's name and current liability insurance for the vehicle on file, and keeps the vehicle operable — able to be moved under its own power or towed on its own wheels. The cure period is the number of calendar days after a compliance notice within which the tenant must cure the problem; the termination notice period is the number of calendar days between a compliance termination notice and the termination date.

| Space class | Current registration kept on file | Current liability insurance kept on file | Vehicle must be operable | Cure period after a compliance notice | Termination notice period |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Uncovered Car Space | Yes | Yes | Yes | 30 days | 30 days |
| Bluegate Uncovered RV & Boat Space (up to 30 ft) | Yes | Yes | Yes | 30 days | 30 days |
| Bluegate Uncovered RV & Boat Space (31-45 ft) | Yes | Yes | Yes | 30 days | 30 days |
| Bluegate Covered RV & Boat Space (up to 30 ft) | Yes | Yes | Yes | 30 days | 30 days |
| Bluegate Covered RV & Boat Space (31-45 ft) | Yes | Yes | Yes | 30 days | 30 days |
| Bluegate Enclosed Vehicle Garage | Yes | Yes | Yes | 30 days | 30 days |

**Changing the vehicle on file.** The swap allowance is the number of changes of the vehicle on file allowed per agreement in any rolling 365-day window; the vehicle swap fee of the space class is the fee for changing the vehicle on file.

| Space class | Swap allowance per rolling 365 days | Vehicle swap fee of the class |
|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Uncovered Car Space | 2 | $15.00 |
| Bluegate Uncovered RV & Boat Space (up to 30 ft) | 2 | $25.00 |
| Bluegate Uncovered RV & Boat Space (31-45 ft) | 2 | $25.00 |
| Bluegate Covered RV & Boat Space (up to 30 ft) | 2 | $25.00 |
| Bluegate Covered RV & Boat Space (31-45 ft) | 2 | $25.00 |
| Bluegate Enclosed Vehicle Garage | 2 | $25.00 |

Points of reading: the three document and condition requirements, the 30-day cure period, the 30-day termination notice period and the allowance of 2 vehicle changes are uniform across all six classes; the class fee for a vehicle change is $15.00 for the Bluegate Uncovered Car Space and $25.00 for every other class.
